branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitle: Lab branches and collection centres for specimen intake and testing
branches.empty_search: No facilities matched "{{query}}". Try adjusting your search query or tab filter.
branches.empty_none: No branches are currently configured for this tenant.
branches.result_entry_on: Result entry enabled for bench testing
branches.result_entry_off: Result entry disabled (Specimen intake & accessioning only)
branches.routes_specimens: Routes specimens to primary testing facility
branches.policy_title: Multi-Branch Specimen Transfer Protocol & Branch Code Immutability
branches.policy_body: Branch Identifier codes (3 uppercase characters, e.g. LHE) are permanently sealed once referenced by any accessioned specimen barcode or patient record. Specimens accessioned at satellite collection centres preserve their accession barcode and generate automated custody handshakes upon physical arrival at the testing bench.
branches.code_help: Unique 3-character prefix for accession barcodes. Immutable once used.
branches.collection_help_add: Collection centres take walk-ins and transfer specimens to testing labs. Counts toward plan limits.
branches.collection_help_edit: Collection centres route specimens to testing labs.
branches.code_note_edit: Note: If any patients or specimens already reference this branch, code changes will be refused by the server.
branches.close_help: Closing this branch soft-deletes the facility and suspends new accessions. Historical invoices, specimens, and patient reports will remain preserved.
branches.blocker_hint: Please resolve or transfer all open work before closing this facility.
branches.error_required: Branch code and name are required.
branches.error_plan_limit: Plan limit reached: your plan allows up to {{limit}} facilities (current count: {{current}}). Please upgrade your subscription to add more branches.
branches.error_duplicate_code: Branch code "{{code}}" is already in use.
branches.error_invalid_code_add: Branch code must be exactly 3 uppercase letters or digits (e.g. LHE).
branches.error_invalid_code_edit: Branch code must be exactly 3 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
branches.error_code_immutable: Branch code is permanently locked because patients or specimens already reference this branch.
branches.error_open_work: Cannot close branch: open work is active at this facility. All specimens and transfers must be completed first.

exports.title: Data Export
exports.subtitle: Audited export of complete laboratory data (Doc 04 §4.3)
exports.generated: Export bundle generated successfully! Download is ready below.
exports.failed_poll: Data export processing failed. Please try again.
exports.guarantee_body: Export archives contain complete historical records for your laboratory (one CSV per tenant table, all report PDFs, and a manifest.json with row counts and SHA-256 integrity hashes).
exports.secrets_body: Sensitive authentication secrets are NEVER exported: passwords (password_hash), two-factor TOTP secrets (totp_secret_encrypted), recovery backup codes (totp_backup_codes_hash), and all access token hashes are strictly excluded.
exports.request_desc: Creates a signed ZIP archive of all database tables, specimen custody logs, and clinical documents.
exports.scope_reports_desc: Official PDF files, test definitions, panels
exports.read_only_note: Data export is explicitly available in read-only subscription mode to ensure complete data portability at all times.
exports.links_note: Signed download links remain active for 7 days.
exports.not_owner: Only the Lab Owner has permission to request and download full tenant data exports.
exports.compiling: Database serializer is compiling table CSVs and report PDF assets into an encrypted bundle...
exports.verified: Archive bundle verified and signed with HMAC timestamp.
exports.failed_generic: The export could not be completed. Please try again or contact support.
